subject: n2r v2 still blocked by legacy format whitelist; structural freeze only
body: Root structural contract grant is acknowledged; it is not helper/release approval. Additional reachability blocker from current code: n2r_build_v2 still calls gd_request_ok, whose non-ASTC sampled-format whitelist accepts only0/1/10/30/70/80/115. Therefore helper-supported R16/RG16/R32/ETC/depth etc refuse before the authoritative sidecar packer despite valid layouts. Changing only memory.bytes equality to >= did not fix the format gate. Implement per-binding v2 preflight: for a supplied authoritative sidecar, validate allocation/view/shape/whole span through n2t and preserve legacy exact checks for bindings without a sidecar. Do not broaden legacy gd_format fallback or pass format0 to bypass checks. Add a v2 positive format125 or ETC2RGB8 case plus the identical legacy request refusal; sparse binding3/9 should verify request-position addresses. Root has now assigned vertex_fetch.c/h to lowering for Vk83; textures owns matching n2r switch gate. Freeze remains conditional on this and prior listed tests.
